base: Personal representative: appraised value of probate personal property plus proceeds of authorized real property sales (S.C. Code § 62-3-719(a)); court fee: gross value of the probate estate per inventory (S.C. Code § 8-21-770(B)).

schedules.text: Not more than 5% of appraised personal property plus authorized real estate sale proceeds; minimum commission $50; plus up to 5% of income (S.C. Code § 62-3-719(a),(b)).
schedules.capNote: Maximum; the $50 minimum governs bases up to $1,000; income commission (5%) not included.

schedules.text: Court fee, not a fiduciary fee: $25 under $5,000; $45 from $5,000; $67.50 from $20,000; $95 from $60,000; $95 plus 0.15% of the value between $100,000 and $600,000; that amount ($845 at $600,000) plus 0.25% above $600,000 (S.C. Code § 8-21-770(B)).
schedules.capNote: Upper bounds encoded as x.99 because the statute uses 'less than'.
